## Document or section

Link the repository file/heading or public documentation page. Do not link private uploaded documents.

## Reader problem

What is missing, inaccurate, inconsistent, or difficult to understand?

## Proposed correction

Provide suggested wording or the information the reader needs.

## Supporting evidence

Link authoritative documentation or a reproducible project behavior where relevant. Identify whether a statement describes a proposal or implemented behavior.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The correction is accurate and consistent with related project documents.
- [ ] Examples and links are valid and contain no sensitive information.
